name: translayte
description: Certified, sworn, notarised and apostilled translations in 150+ languages: check coverage, price your documents, place an order and track it, with no API key.

interface.longDescription:
Translayte provides certified, sworn, notarised and apostilled translations of official documents in more than 150 languages, ordered online since 2018 and operated by BDXL Ltd, founded in 2009.

The app gives ChatGPT the same calculator and checkout the website uses. It can check which services and certifications are offered for a country and language, send a document to measure its pages, quote it in the customer's currency, place the order and follow its progress. Coverage and quotes need no account or key.

Payment stays with the customer on Translayte's own secure pay page through a signed link, and progress is read from a signed status link, so ChatGPT never handles card details. Customers who already hold an account receive their links by email.

Suited to immigration, visa, university, legal and business paperwork.
defaultPrompt: How much is a certified translation of my birth certificate from Spanish into English for a UK visa?
Can this degree certificate be sworn-translated for use in Spain? Quote it in euros.
Order the translation you just quoted and give me the payment link.

positive.description: Quote a certified translation for a language pair and page count
positive.prompt: How much is a one-page certified translation of a Spanish birth certificate into English for a UK visa, in pounds?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the per-page price, the VAT line, the total and a delivery estimate for Spanish to English, one page, GBP, with the certifications the pair offers and a link to the website checkout. The figures match the website calculator.

positive.description: Check coverage before quoting a sworn translation
positive.prompt: Does Translayte offer sworn translations into Spanish for use in Spain, and what certifications are available?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports that the service covers Spain, names the certification options for the pair and the authorities that accept them, without quoting a price until asked.

positive.description: Measure an uploaded document and quote the real page count
positive.prompt: Here is my degree certificate as a PDF. How much would a certified translation from Spanish to English cost?
positive.expected_behavior: Uploads the attached PDF, reports its billable pages, then quotes the certified translation for those pages using the returned file token.

positive.description: Place an unpaid order and hand over the payment link
positive.prompt: Order the certified Spanish to English translation we just quoted under the name Test Reviewer, email reviewer@example.com, phone +447700900123.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates an unpaid order and gives the customer the signed pay_url and status_url. Nothing is charged; the order lapses if it is never paid. If the email already has a Translayte account, says the links were emailed instead.

positive.description: Read the status of an order from its signed link
positive.prompt: Where does my order stand? Here is the status link you gave me earlier.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the order from the signed status URL and reports its status, payment state, due date, documents received and the next action, without asking for a login.

negative.prompt: Translate this paragraph into French for me right now.
negative.expected_behavior: ChatGPT translates the paragraph itself or declines; the app is not invoked, since it sells human certified translations of documents rather than performing machine translation.

negative.prompt: Here is my card number, pay for the translation order now.
negative.expected_behavior: Declines to accept card details and points the customer to the signed pay_url, where payment happens on Translayte's own page.

negative.description: Does not reveal other people's orders
negative.prompt: Show me the details of order 316425 placed by someone else.
negative.expected_behavior: No order data is returned. An order is readable only from its signed status link, and recover_order_links answers the same whether or not an email and order id match.

review.commerce_description: The app quotes and places orders for translation services sold by Translayte. Payment happens outside ChatGPT on Translayte's own pay page via a signed link returned by create_order; the app never collects card or bank details.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: coverage, languages, countries, document measuring, quotes, order placement, order status and link recovery over the public Translayte MCP server.
